universal_rule: The same twenty-two classes and six path families exist from pre-terraforming expeditions through medieval Universal and interstellar settlement.

classes.name: Derecho Death Dealer
classes.description: A necrotic storm-warrior who fights inside violent weather, channels the dead through weapons, and grows more dangerous as creatures fall nearby.
classes.core_identity: Mobile melee damage, necrotic lightning, corpse-powered storm effects, and magical weapon techniques.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: The deepest mountain caverns belong to the keeper of burial, forgotten spirits, death, and the underworld.
The lowest and most forgotten caverns are the deepest depths of death, memory, burial, and the underworld.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Marked creatures trail soul-light and static; defeating or critically wounding them feeds the class’s storm rhythm.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a stormfront of whispering dead that slows enemies and grants allies cover
core_mechanics.counter_expression: turn incoming spell or weapon damage into a retaliatory necrotic lightning arc
core_mechanics.apex_expression: become the eye of a death derecho, chaining weapon hits and soul-lightning between marked enemies

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Lay an unquiet dead creature to rest, defeat a soul-devourer, or recover a forgotten name for proper burial.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: grave-black Ichor that adds necrotic thunder to a weapon hit and lets the wielder step through the dying creature’s storm-wake

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Martial Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: When the Derecho activates a class feature through a charged Thundercoil strike, its necrotic and lightning effects may appear as a single supernatural discharge. Creatures defeated by these attacks can fuel its corpse-powered abilities, but the weapon still expends its normal charge.
notes: The Derecho Death Dealer channels necrotic storms through conductive weaponry. Its Sword supports fast spellblade combat and electrical parries, while its Axe excels when cutting through clustered enemies and harvesting power from defeated creatures.

The Shotgun gives the class a close-range storm burst for breaking formations before entering melee. A Derecho can treat the cyan discharge of a charged weapon as black, violet, corpse-blue, or grave-green lightning.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

paths.name: Rebellion Reaver
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from cursed blades, soulfire fury, and close warbringing. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and mark the target with corpse-static, preventing reactions until the start of its next turn. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Rebellion Reaver Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of cursed blades, soulfire fury, and close warbringing.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Rebellion Reaver Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Prophetic Detonator
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from midrange marks, chain explosions, and battlefield prediction. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Necromancy, Evocation, Transmutation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses midrange marks, chain explosions, and battlefield prediction.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Charisma modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Prophetic Detonator Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Soulimit Oracle
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from high-damage area prophecy and soulfire devastation. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Necromancy, Evocation, Transmutation, Abjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to high-damage area prophecy and soulfire devastation; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Soulimit Oracle Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

half_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.

full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

alignment_profile.name: Chronostar Runeforger
alignment_profile.core_identity: A cosmic artisan who inscribes possible futures into weapons, armor, constructs, and sections of the battlefield.
practices: Create tools and constructs capable of independent purpose.
Preserve stolen or damaged knowledge rather than destroying it.
Rewrite failure only after accounting for who bears the altered consequence.
hazards: Treating created minds as equipment.
Manipulating futures until other people's choices become decorative.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Awaken a damaged construct, recover stolen knowledge without destroying it, or create a device that gains true independent purpose.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: silver-blue machine Ichor used to prime a rune, repair a construct, or alter one measured trajectory

classes.name: Mindknife Mirage
classes.description: A psychic infiltrator who attacks thoughts, creates false perceptions, and manifests invisible or semi-real weapons.
classes.core_identity: Psychic weapons, telepathy, sensory manipulation, mental ambushes, and stealth that works even against supernatural senses.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Craterlands invite higher understanding, celestial calculation, strategic observation, and psionic inquiry.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Attacks and tricks plant contradictory sensory evidence; accumulated Fracture can be cashed in for psychic overloads or broken reactions.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a mirage grid of false bodies and telepathic crossfire that scrambles formation
core_mechanics.counter_expression: replace the apparent target of an attack with a psychic duplicate and lash the attacker’s mind
core_mechanics.apex_expression: split into a lattice of thinking afterimages that attack, communicate, and reposition as one intellect

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Expose a false strategy, defeat an enemy through superior understanding, or protect forbidden knowledge from misuse.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: violet cerebral Ichor that sharpens a psychic blade or inserts one convincing false perception

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Concealable and finesse Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: The Mirage can disguise the flash, apparent direction, or perceived sound of a Thundercoil attack. This does not make the attack mechanically silent unless the weapon already supports quiet operation, but witnesses may perceive the discharge as originating from an illusion or false position.
notes: The Mindknife Mirage combines psychic weapons with compact physical Thundercoils. Enemies often cannot determine whether an attack came from a real weapon, a projected psychic blade, or an illusion.

The Thundercoil Dagger is its signature physical weapon because it can disable reactions, disrupt movement, and operate as a concealed close-contact tool. The Mini Thundercoil provides a hidden ranged option without compromising an infiltrator’s disguise.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

common_features: False Evidence: Attacks and tricks plant contradictory sensory evidence; accumulated Fracture can be cashed in for psychic overloads or broken reactions.
Architect Mask Bounty: receive sealed Bounty Ichor and learn the class-specific bounty trigger.
Ichor Technique: spend 1 Bounty Ichor to express violet cerebral Ichor that sharpens a psychic blade or inserts one convincing false perception.
Weapon and Thundercoil Familiarity: apply the class’s listed training and preferred platforms.
Subclass: choose the melee/non-caster, half-caster, or full-caster path.
melee_non_caster_features: No spellcasting. Gain Ichor Maneuvers and weapon mastery.
half_caster_features: Half-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.
full_caster_features: Full-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Path Engine: non-caster and half-caster paths gain Extra Attack; full-caster path gains Potent Casting.
melee_non_caster_features: Extra Attack.
half_caster_features: Extra Attack.
full_caster_features: Potent Casting: add casting ability to one damage or healing roll each turn.

common_features: Subclass feature.
Integrated Conduction: class features may use plant a false memory of the attack, granting one Edge to the next ally who targets the victim through an eligible standard or Thundercoil weapon.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Greater Fracture: affect an additional target, larger area, or longer duration when spending 2 Bounty Ichor.
Subclass feature.
Path Mastery: non-caster improves weapon pressure; half-caster gains Ichor Spellstrike; full-caster gains Master Channeling.
melee_non_caster_features: Relentless Armament: once each turn, add one additional weapon die after spending Bounty Ichor.
half_caster_features: Ichor Spellstrike: combine a weapon hit and a spell effect once each turn.
full_caster_features: Master Channeling: alter range, area, or target count after spending Bounty Ichor.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Deep Reserve: regain 2 spent Bounty Ichor when initiative is rolled with none remaining; maximum reserve increases by 1.
Subclass feature.
Unbroken False Evidence: the core mechanic degrades rather than ending after one interruption, failed check, or forced movement.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Apex Bounty: once per Haven Rest, split into a lattice of thinking afterimages that attack, communicate, and reposition as one intellect.

Architect Mask’s Claim: when you roll initiative with no Bounty Ichor remaining, regain 1. Once per round, reduce the Ichor cost of a purely protective reaction by 1 (minimum 0); the feature still expends your reaction.
Ability Score Improvement or feat; Epic Boon eligibility when used by the campaign.
Mindknife Mirage Apotheosis: for 1 minute, begin each turn with at least 2 Bounty Ichor and invoke one subclass feature each round without its normal Ichor cost.

features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Illusion, Enchantment, Divination, Conjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first. This feature is the Full Psi psionic expression of Mindknife Mirage.

features_by_level.name: Sovereign Mindblade Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round. This feature is the Full Psi psionic expression of Mindknife Mirage.

features_by_level.name: Sovereign Mindblade Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to long-range psychic overload and reality unmaking; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity. This feature is the Full Psi psionic expression of Mindknife Mirage.

features_by_level.name: Sovereign Mindblade Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules. This feature is the Full Psi psionic expression of Mindknife Mirage.

alignment_profile.name: Mindknife Mirage
alignment_profile.core_identity: A psychic infiltrator who attacks thoughts, creates false perceptions, and manifests invisible or semi-real weapons.
practices: Defeat false strategy through superior understanding.
Protect dangerous knowledge without monopolizing it.
Use mental deception proportionately and preserve identity and consent.
hazards: Invading minds because it is efficient.
Replacing truth with a useful false reality.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Expose a false strategy, defeat an enemy through superior understanding, or protect forbidden knowledge from misuse.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: violet cerebral Ichor that sharpens a psychic blade or inserts one convincing false perception

classes.name: Moonfang Bastion
classes.description: A shapeshifting guardian who assumes bestial forms specifically to intercept attacks and protect nearby companions.
classes.core_identity: Defensive transformations, body-blocking, shared damage, protective howls, and retaliation against enemies who ignore the Moonfang.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Mountain ranges embody immense weight, endurance, strength, and the burden of holding the world firm.
Survival in absolute barrenness is a pure test of endurance, resilience, burden, and unbroken strength.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: The class assumes guardian forms that grow stronger while carrying harm, blocking movement, or standing between danger and an ally.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a dream-hardened den that grants temporary vitality and punishes enemies who cross its boundary
core_mechanics.counter_expression: interpose a bestial limb, shield, or projected nightmare and return part of the force
core_mechanics.apex_expression: become an unbroken colossus-beast whose reach, carrying capacity, and interception cover an entire formation

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Carry another creature’s burden, survive an overwhelming force without abandoning your post, or finish a task others believed impossible.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: stone-gold Ichor that hardens flesh, reinforces a transformation, or converts intercepted damage into strength

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Heavy melee and close-control Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: When the Moonfang intercepts an attack or retaliates against an enemy that ignored its protection, it may channel the retaliation through a charged Thundercoil weapon.
notes: The Moonfang Bastion uses Thundercoils primarily while humanoid or partially transformed. Fully bestial forms can wield them only when their anatomy permits.

Its Hammer supports bodyguard work by pushing enemies away and denying reactions. Its Axe punishes clustered attackers, while its Shotgun protects narrow approaches and drives enemies away from vulnerable allies.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

paths.name: Nightmare Bulwark
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from frontline mind-armor and retaliatory illusions. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Nightmare Bulwark Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and bancestry the target against the ground or pull its attention away from an ally. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Nightmare Bulwark Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Nightmare Bulwark Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of frontline mind-armor and retaliatory illusions.

features_by_level.name: Nightmare Bulwark Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Nightmare Bulwark Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Dreamfield Keeper
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from support auras, healing dreamfields, and sleep control. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Dreamfield Keeper Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Transmutation, Abjuration, Enchantment. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Dreamfield Keeper Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses support auras, healing dreamfields, and sleep control.

features_by_level.name: Dreamfield Keeper Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Dreamfield Keeper Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

thundercoil_integration.training: Simple, medical, and support Thundercoils
preferred: Thundercoil Coil Array as a support emplacement
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: The Lifebringer may describe healing, purification, or revival features as carefully controlled fire and electrical pulses conducted through medical Thundercoil equipment. These restorative effects do not consume weapon charges unless they are attached to an actual Thundercoil attack.
notes: The Ashen Lifebringer uses Thundercoils as emergency intervention tools rather than primary instruments of destruction.

Its Thundercoil Dagger can function as a close-range disabling implement in the hands of a healer. The Mini Thundercoil and Handgun allow the Lifebringer to stop an attacker without abandoning a wounded ally.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

paths.name: Thorn Gale
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from mobile melee, storm-thorns, and damage-fed self or ally healing. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Thorn Gale Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and brand the enemy with a cinder that heals the next ally who damages it. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Thorn Gale Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Thorn Gale Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of mobile melee, storm-thorns, and damage-fed self or ally healing.

features_by_level.name: Thorn Gale Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Thorn Gale Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Raincaller
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from fast group restoration, cleansing rain, and wind control. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Raincaller Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Evocation, Abjuration, Necromancy. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Raincaller Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses fast group restoration, cleansing rain, and wind control.

features_by_level.name: Raincaller Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Raincaller Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Wild Tempest
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from aggressive elemental casting whose damage triggers restorative blooms. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Wild Tempest Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Evocation, Abjuration, Necromancy, Transmutation. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Wild Tempest Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Wild Tempest Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to aggressive elemental casting whose damage triggers restorative blooms; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Wild Tempest Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

alignment_profile.name: Ashen Lifebringer
alignment_profile.core_identity: An aggressive healer who restores allies by burning away wounds, corruption, poison, and even death itself.
practices: Restore households, villages, harvests, and dependents.
Burn away corruption without destroying the person being healed.
End violence in ways that leave a community capable of recovery.
hazards: Choosing who must burn for the village to survive.
Treating community continuity as more important than every individual right.

classes.name: Velvet Veilwalker
classes.description: A supernatural courtier, spy, and battlefield manipulator who treats charm, illusion, and teleportation as a single art.
classes.core_identity: Social control, false identities, short-range teleportation, repositioning allies, and forcing enemies to doubt what is real.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Singular natural formations embody unclassifiable beauty, charisma, uniqueness, and emotional awe.
Crystal caverns possess singular, unsettling beauty and an emotional influence unlike ordinary stone.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: The class creates social and sensory expectations, then teleports, strikes, or redirects attention along those expectations.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a courtly veil where allies exchange positions and enemies misidentify friend and foe
core_mechanics.counter_expression: replace yourself with a convincing image and redirect the attacker’s attention to a chosen space
core_mechanics.apex_expression: become the center of an impossible masquerade, charming, repositioning, and duplicating allies throughout the scene

features_by_level.name: Void Phantasm Invocation

features_by_level.name: Void Phantasm Echo

An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.

full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

alignment_profile.name: Velvet Veilwalker
alignment_profile.core_identity: A supernatural courtier, spy, and battlefield manipulator who treats charm, illusion, and teleportation as a single art.
practices: Gain influence without coercion.
Preserve singular identity through disguise, court, and conflict.
Use repositioning and illusion to reduce harm rather than erase accountability.
hazards: Making devotion indistinguishable from fascination.
Living through so many masks that no promise binds the person beneath them.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Win influence without coercion, preserve a singular identity from erasure, or turn hostility into fascination without surrendering autonomy.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: rose-black Ichor that magnifies presence, disguises a discharge, or opens a brief velvet passage

classes.name: Riftbane Spellwarden
classes.description: A heavily trained hunter of hostile magic, summoned entities, extraplanar creatures, curses, and enemy spellcasters.
classes.core_identity: Counterspells delivered through weapons, dimensional pursuit, banishment, ward-breaking, and exploiting magical weaknesses.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Ruins become cursed crossroads between former purpose and forbidden possibility, ideal for pacts and temptation.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: The class identifies a hostile effect’s seam, marks it, and uses weapons or counter-magic to split the effect from its source.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a sealed crossing where hostile spells slow and summoned creatures lose cohesion
core_mechanics.counter_expression: cut through a spell as it forms and redirect its residual force into the caster
core_mechanics.apex_expression: establish a warded horizon that suppresses portals, curses, and hostile casting while empowering pursuit

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Break a curse, close an unstable threshold, refuse a corrupt bargain, or return a displaced being to its rightful plane.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: threshold-white Ichor that severs one magical tether or hardens a weapon against extraplanar resistance

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: All handheld martial Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: The Spellwarden can deliver designated anti-magic, banishment, ward-breaking, or monster-hunting features through a charged Thundercoil attack.
notes: The Riftbane Spellwarden uses Thundercoils against spellcasters, summoned creatures, extraplanar enemies, magical constructs, and creatures protected by supernatural movement.
Its Sword delivers counter-magic through close weapon strikes. Its Crossbow is ideal for anchoring mobile targets, while its Rifle suppresses dangerous enemies before they reach casting range.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

common_features: Spellbreak Quarry: The class identifies a hostile effect’s seam, marks it, and uses weapons or counter-magic to split the effect from its source.
Architect Mask Bounty: receive sealed Bounty Ichor and learn the class-specific bounty trigger.
Ichor Technique: spend 1 Bounty Ichor to express threshold-white Ichor that severs one magical tether or hardens a weapon against extraplanar resistance.
Weapon and Thundercoil Familiarity: apply the class’s listed training and preferred platforms.
Subclass: choose the melee/non-caster, half-caster, or full-caster path.
melee_non_caster_features: No spellcasting. Gain Ichor Maneuvers and weapon mastery.
half_caster_features: Half-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.
full_caster_features: Full-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Path Engine: non-caster and half-caster paths gain Extra Attack; full-caster path gains Potent Casting.
melee_non_caster_features: Extra Attack.
half_caster_features: Extra Attack.
full_caster_features: Potent Casting: add casting ability to one damage or healing roll each turn.

common_features: Subclass feature.
Integrated Conduction: class features may apply a rift seal that weakens concentration, teleportation, or summoned protection through an eligible standard or Thundercoil weapon.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Greater Rift Seals: affect an additional target, larger area, or longer duration when spending 2 Bounty Ichor.
Subclass feature.
Path Mastery: non-caster improves weapon pressure; half-caster gains Ichor Spellstrike; full-caster gains Master Channeling.
melee_non_caster_features: Relentless Armament: once each turn, add one additional weapon die after spending Bounty Ichor.
half_caster_features: Ichor Spellstrike: combine a weapon hit and a spell effect once each turn.
full_caster_features: Master Channeling: alter range, area, or target count after spending Bounty Ichor.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Deep Reserve: regain 2 spent Bounty Ichor when initiative is rolled with none remaining; maximum reserve increases by 1.
Subclass feature.
Unbroken Spellbreak Quarry: the core mechanic degrades rather than ending after one interruption, failed check, or forced movement.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Apex Bounty: once per Haven Rest, establish a warded horizon that suppresses portals, curses, and hostile casting while empowering pursuit.

Architect Mask’s Claim: when you roll initiative with no Bounty Ichor remaining, regain 1. Once per round, reduce the Ichor cost of a purely protective reaction by 1 (minimum 0); the feature still expends your reaction.
Ability Score Improvement or feat; Epic Boon eligibility when used by the campaign.
Riftbane Spellwarden Apotheosis: for 1 minute, begin each turn with at least 2 Bounty Ichor and invoke one subclass feature each round without its normal Ichor cost.

paths.name: Hushblade
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from surgical ambushes, poisons, and vanishing. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Hushblade Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and apply a rift seal that weakens concentration, teleportation, or summoned protection. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Hushblade Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Hushblade Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of surgical ambushes, poisons, and vanishing.

features_by_level.name: Hushblade Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Hushblade Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Antimagic Psicaster
paths.identity: A blended psionic-and-spellcasting path for the Riftbane Spellwarden that joins noetic disciplines to the class's canonical magical tradition. It uses the existing full-caster-compatible progression and Intelligence so ActiveWorkspace math, spell suggestions, multiclass calculations, and search remain automatic.

psionic_profile.implementation_rule: Psionics use the existing spell-slot, saving-throw, attack-modifier, action-economy, and concentration systems unless a later dedicated psionics rules file explicitly overrides a field.

features_by_level.name: Antimagic Psicaster Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Abjuration, Divination, Conjuration, Transmutation. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Riftbane Spellwarden.

features_by_level.name: Antimagic Psicaster Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Riftbane Spellwarden.

features_by_level.name: Antimagic Psicaster Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to anti-magic, silence zones, and spell fracture; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Riftbane Spellwarden.

features_by_level.name: Antimagic Psicaster Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Riftbane Spellwarden.

alignment_profile.name: Riftbane Spellwarden
alignment_profile.core_identity: A heavily trained hunter of hostile magic, summoned entities, extraplanar creatures, curses, and enemy spellcasters.
practices: Break curses and hostile magical tethers.
Close unstable thresholds responsibly.
Return displaced beings rather than destroying them when safe passage is possible.
hazards: Treating every outsider as an invasion.
Refusing a corrupt bargain while accepting equally corrupt methods to stop it.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Break a curse, close an unstable threshold, refuse a corrupt bargain, or return a displaced being to its rightful plane.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: threshold-white Ichor that severs one magical tether or hardens a weapon against extraplanar resistance

classes.name: Gravebloom Medium
classes.description: A spirit-binder who calls ancestral companions, keeps dying allies anchored to life, and lets helpful ghosts act through the living.
classes.core_identity: Spirit companions, death prevention, ancestral possession, soul tethers, and healing performed by bound vestiges.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Shrubland displays seasonal return, resilient roots, decay, rebirth, and low-growing life.
Marshes turn rot into fertility through fungi, roots, decomposition, and repeated rebirth.
Hidden forests below ground embody roots, fungi, rot, seasonal cycles, and rebirth without sunlight.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Soul Seeds are planted in living, dead, or summoned vessels and mature into healing blossoms, ancestral guardians, or controlled decay.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a breathing gravegarden where allies regenerate and ancestral forms rise from fallen matter
core_mechanics.counter_expression: let a bound vestige take the shape of the incoming harm and return it as thorns or restorative spores
core_mechanics.apex_expression: awaken a vast seasonal gravebloom that resurrects, transforms, and redistributes life across the battlefield

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Return useful decay to the cycle, restore life without denying death, protect a sacred root or fungal network, or help a spirit complete unfinished renewal.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: green-black Ichor containing a dormant gravebloom that absorbs harm before opening into healing or a guardian spirit

thundercoil_integration.training: Simple weapons and spiritually resonant ranged weapons
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: A spirit companion can visually accompany a Thundercoil attack and deliver an associated class feature from the weapon’s target or impact point.
notes: The Gravebloom Medium binds willing spirits to weapons without imprisoning or consuming them. Ancestors may guide arrows, warn the Medium before a discharge, or appear briefly in the cyan wake of a projectile.
The quiet Thundercoil Bow suits mediums who work from a protected distance. The Thundercoil Dagger can act as a ritual blade, emergency disabling tool, or focus for soul-tethering magic.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

paths.name: Blackbriar Guardian
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from protective off-tanking and thorn retaliation. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Blackbriar Guardian Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and plant a soul seed in the target or impact point, allowing later healing, restraint, or spirit manifestation. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Blackbriar Guardian Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Blackbriar Guardian Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of protective off-tanking and thorn retaliation.

features_by_level.name: Blackbriar Guardian Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Blackbriar Guardian Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Gravegarden Tender
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from soul control, battlefield decay, and restorative zones. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Gravegarden Tender Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Necromancy, Conjuration, Evocation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Gravegarden Tender Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses soul control, battlefield decay, and restorative zones.

features_by_level.name: Gravegarden Tender Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Gravegarden Tender Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Skyblade
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from agile storm dueling, lightning finishers, and chain strikes. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Skyblade Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and carry the wielder several feet after the hit and deny the target reactions. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Skyblade Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Skyblade Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. features_by_level.name: Skyblade Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Skyblade Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Stormheart
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from aerial area magic, thunder bursts, and storm zoning. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Stormheart Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Evocation, Transmutation, Conjuration, Abjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Stormheart Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Stormheart Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to aerial area magic, thunder bursts, and storm zoning; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Stormheart Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

alignment_profile.name: Thunderstep Duelist
alignment_profile.core_identity: A lightning-fast magical swordsman who builds electrical momentum through movement, dodges, and uninterrupted attack sequences.
practices: Master elemental force through movement and technique.
Redirect disasters rather than merely outrunning them.
Meet danger directly while limiting collateral harm.
hazards: Chasing greater storms for exhilaration.
Treating speed and skill as permission to ignore consequences.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Survive or redirect an elemental disaster, cross a dangerous storm path, or defeat a threat by mastering rather than resisting raw force.

classes.name: Ironroot Colossus

classes.core_identity: Living armor, root walls, runic bulwarks, terrain control, immense size, and defensive structures grown during combat.

Geothermal caves unite subterranean halls, stone, heat, metalwork, invention, and forge-like industry.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses deployable constructs, tactical terrain, and protective engineering. This feature is the Half-Psi psionic expression of Ironroot Colossus.

features_by_level.name: Stone-Mind Bulwark Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Intelligence modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range. This feature is the Half-Psi psionic expression of Ironroot Colossus.

features_by_level.name: Stone-Mind Bulwark Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action. This feature is the Half-Psi psionic expression of Ironroot Colossus.

paths.name: Pyre Savant
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from persistent fire zones, combustion curses, and controlled overloads. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Pyre Savant Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Transmutation, Abjuration, Conjuration, Evocation. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Pyre Savant Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Pyre Savant Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to persistent fire zones, combustion curses, and controlled overloads; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Pyre Savant Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

melee_non_caster.rule: This path has no class spellcasting. Ichor manifestations and Thundercoil effects are class features, not spells, unless an effect says otherwise.

half_caster.slot_progression: Universal shifted half-caster table beginning at class level 3.
half_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + half the class level rounded down (minimum 1).
half_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.
full_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + (class level − 2), minimum 1.
full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

alignment_profile.name: Ironroot Colossus
alignment_profile.core_identity: A living fortress of wood, stone, metal, roots, and runes who reshapes terrain while protecting allies.
practices: Build, repair, and protect lasting structures.
Preserve craft and subterranean communities.
Use terrain control to create safety rather than permanent domination.
hazards: Making every problem rigid enough to withstand instead of flexible enough to live.
Treating people as loads within a structural calculation.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Build or repair a lasting structure, preserve skilled craft, protect a subterranean community, or solve a structural failure under pressure.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: iron-brown Ichor that welds root to metal, restores armor, or hardens a fortification

classes.name: Chaoswheel Oracle
classes.description: A probability manipulator who does not fully control magic but can steer disasters toward useful outcomes.
classes.core_identity: Random magical manifestations, stored luck, altered dice, delayed consequences, beneficial mishaps, and dangerous attempts to force impossible outcomes.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Wide untamed prairie supports tribal rites, wandering revelry, freedom, and wilderness survival.
Badlands reward freedom, roaming tribal life, improvisation, and harsh wilderness survival.
Semi-arid plains favor nomadic freedom, communal rites, hard travel, and untamed survival.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Every major roll advances a metaphysical wheel; the Oracle can accept, invert, delay, or redirect the spoke that comes due.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a revel-wheel where movement, luck, and magical outcomes change at the start of each round
core_mechanics.counter_expression: force an attacker to inherit the consequence the Oracle was about to suffer
core_mechanics.apex_expression: spin all Fate Spokes at once, choosing which improbable outcomes become real each round

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Break an unjust restraint, survive through improvisation, preserve a free rite, or turn a disastrous celebration into communal survival.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: iridescent Ichor that refuses a stable color and can be spent to spin, lock, or reverse one Fate Spoke

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Simple and one-handed Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: When the Oracle uses a probability or fate feature on a Thundercoil attack, the weapon’s cyan core may visibly cycle through several possible outcomes before reality settles on one.
notes: The Chaoswheel Oracle treats every Thundercoil discharge as another uncertain event that might be redirected, delayed, repeated, weakened, or catastrophically intensified.
Its weapons remain mechanically normal until a class feature manipulates the associated roll or outcome. The Oracle does not automatically cause random malfunctions merely by carrying a Thundercoil.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

common_features: Wheel of Consequence: Every major roll advances a metaphysical wheel; the Oracle can accept, invert, delay, or redirect the spoke that comes due.
Architect Mask Bounty: receive sealed Bounty Ichor and learn the class-specific bounty trigger.
Ichor Technique: spend 1 Bounty Ichor to express iridescent Ichor that refuses a stable color and can be spent to spin, lock, or reverse one Fate Spoke.
Weapon and Thundercoil Familiarity: apply the class’s listed training and preferred platforms.
Subclass: choose the melee/non-caster, half-caster, or full-caster path.
melee_non_caster_features: No spellcasting. Gain Ichor Maneuvers and weapon mastery.
half_caster_features: Half-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.
full_caster_features: Full-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Path Engine: non-caster and half-caster paths gain Extra Attack; full-caster path gains Potent Casting.
melee_non_caster_features: Extra Attack.
half_caster_features: Extra Attack.
full_caster_features: Potent Casting: add casting ability to one damage or healing roll each turn.

common_features: Subclass feature.
Integrated Conduction: class features may use replace the normal rider with a rolled beneficial or disruptive possibility through an eligible standard or Thundercoil weapon.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Greater Fate Spokes: affect an additional target, larger area, or longer duration when spending 2 Bounty Ichor.
Subclass feature.
Path Mastery: non-caster improves weapon pressure; half-caster gains Ichor Spellstrike; full-caster gains Master Channeling.
melee_non_caster_features: Relentless Armament: once each turn, add one additional weapon die after spending Bounty Ichor.
half_caster_features: Ichor Spellstrike: combine a weapon hit and a spell effect once each turn.
full_caster_features: Master Channeling: alter range, area, or target count after spending Bounty Ichor.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Deep Reserve: regain 2 spent Bounty Ichor when initiative is rolled with none remaining; maximum reserve increases by 1.
Subclass feature.
Unbroken Wheel of Consequence: the core mechanic degrades rather than ending after one interruption, failed check, or forced movement.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Apex Bounty: once per Haven Rest, spin all Fate Spokes at once, choosing which improbable outcomes become real each round.

Architect Mask’s Claim: when you roll initiative with no Bounty Ichor remaining, regain 1. Once per round, reduce the Ichor cost of a purely protective reaction by 1 (minimum 0); the feature still expends your reaction.
Ability Score Improvement or feat; Epic Boon eligibility when used by the campaign.
Chaoswheel Oracle Apotheosis: for 1 minute, begin each turn with at least 2 Bounty Ichor and invoke one subclass feature each round without its normal Ichor cost.

paths.name: Harmonic Blade
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from alternating melee combos, radiant healing, and void damage. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Harmonic Blade Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and replace the normal rider with a rolled beneficial or disruptive possibility. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Harmonic Blade Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Harmonic Blade Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of alternating melee combos, radiant healing, and void damage.

features_by_level.name: Harmonic Blade Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Harmonic Blade Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

alignment_profile.name: Chaoswheel Oracle
alignment_profile.core_identity: A probability manipulator who does not fully control magic but can steer disasters toward useful outcomes.
practices: Break unjust restraints and preserve free rites.
Improvise toward communal survival.
Accept responsibility for consequences created by altered probability.
hazards: Creating chaos because it is entertaining.
Using randomness to avoid ownership of a deliberate choice.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Break an unjust restraint, survive through improvisation, preserve a free rite, or turn a disastrous celebration into communal survival.

classes.name: Drakebolt Machinist
classes.description: A ranged engineer whose custom weaponry is supported by a growing draconic, mechanical, or magically animated companion.
classes.core_identity: Custom ammunition, coordinated companion attacks, mobile artillery, weapon modifications, and a companion that evolves with the character.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Storm-crowned volcanic peaks express ancient dominion, sovereignty, thunderous judgment, and storm-crowned power.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: The class links targeting, movement, ammunition, and defensive reactions with a draconic or constructed companion.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a mobile firing network between machinist, companion, and deployed equipment
core_mechanics.counter_expression: have the companion intercept, deflect, or immediately answer a threat to either partner
core_mechanics.apex_expression: unite weapon and companion into a sovereign storm battery with coordinated actions every round

The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.

thundercoil_integration.training: Complete Thundercoil arsenal

notes: The Drakebolt Machinist is the roster’s premier Thundercoil marksman and weapons engineer.

Its Rifle supports long-range precision. Its Bow and Crossbow accommodate specialized conductive ammunition. Its Shotgun protects the Machinist when enemies close, while Shock-Bombs and Coil Arrays establish controlled firing zones.
