paths.name: Quickcoil Outrider
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from mobile sidearm play, close-range quickdraws, and pursuit. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Quickcoil Outrider Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and let the companion mark, redirect, or retrieve the shot and add a draconic element. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Quickcoil Outrider Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Quickcoil Outrider Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of mobile sidearm play, close-range quickdraws, and pursuit.

features_by_level.name: Quickcoil Outrider Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Quickcoil Outrider Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Arc Ricochet
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from banked lightning shots, crowd control, and tactical gadgets. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Arc Ricochet Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Transmutation, Conjuration, Evocation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Arc Ricochet Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses banked lightning shots, crowd control, and tactical gadgets.

features_by_level.name: Arc Ricochet Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Intelligence modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Arc Ricochet Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Silent Longshot
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from suppressed precision, overwatch, fate-timed shots, and anti-caster disabling. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Silent Longshot Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Transmutation, Conjuration, Evocation, Abjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Silent Longshot Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Silent Longshot Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to suppressed precision, overwatch, fate-timed shots, and anti-caster disabling; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

paths.name: Cinder Cleaver
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from sweeping melee carnage and relentless momentum. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Cinder Cleaver Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and issue a command-discharge that moves an ally or pins the target in place. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Cinder Cleaver Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Cinder Cleaver Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of sweeping melee carnage and relentless momentum.

features_by_level.name: Cinder Cleaver Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Cinder Cleaver Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Revolution Pyromancer
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from firestorm zoning, denial, and explosive rebellion. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Revolution Pyromancer Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Enchantment, Abjuration, Evocation, Divination. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Revolution Pyromancer Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Revolution Pyromancer Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to firestorm zoning, denial, and explosive rebellion; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Revolution Pyromancer Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

alignment_profile.name: Dreadcrown Marshal
alignment_profile.core_identity: A battlefield commander who wins through fear, formation control, commands, and oppressive supernatural presence.
practices: Accept the risks and consequences of command.
Secure objectives without prolonging war for pride.
Use fear and formation as tools rather than ownership of allies.
hazards: Making submission the only acceptable proof of respect.
Using people as extensions of command rather than agents.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Win a contest of dominance, survive martial defeat without submission, secure a battlefield objective, or force a stronger enemy to acknowledge your command.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: iron-red Ichor that hardens a command, empowers a weapon, or makes fear physically oppressive

classes.name: Horizon Shade
classes.description: A supernatural ambusher who occupies several positions through echoes, shadows, and spatial afterimages.
classes.core_identity: Attacking from echoes, swapping locations, simultaneous flanking, false retreats, and devastating opening turns.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Ash-darkened twilight landscapes suit shadows, curses, forbidden magic, and transformative gloom.
Shadowed swamps evoke curses, twilight transformation, obscured paths, and forbidden magic.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Movement leaves actionable shadow-echoes; the Shade can attack, swap, or retreat through them before they dissolve.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a fractured horizon of shadows that enables repeated swaps and false retreats
core_mechanics.counter_expression: let the attack hit a projected body, then reappear from a different echo
core_mechanics.apex_expression: occupy every active echo at once, attacking and moving through all of them as a single turn

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Master a forbidden transformation without losing identity, survive a curse, protect twilight knowledge, or expose a threat hiding within shadow.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: smoke-violet Ichor that fixes one shadow-echo into a temporary body or opens a short twilight passage

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Concealable weapons, bows, and precision firearms
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: A ranged attack may appear to originate from an echo or projected body when a class feature permits attacks through that manifestation.
notes: The Horizon Shade attacks from false positions, elevated shadows, projected echoes, and momentary dimensional openings.

The quiet Thundercoil Bow supports stealthy ranged attacks. The Rifle is reserved for prepared ambushes, while the Dagger and Mini Thundercoil protect the Shade after teleporting into confined spaces.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

alignment_profile.name: Horizon Shade
alignment_profile.core_identity: A supernatural ambusher who occupies several positions through echoes, shadows, and spatial afterimages.
practices: Master forbidden transformation without losing identity.
Expose threats hidden in shadow.
Use echoes and concealment without abandoning accountability.
hazards: Letting survival erase every stable relationship.
Treating an unseen act as an act without consequence.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Master a forbidden transformation without losing identity, survive a curse, protect twilight knowledge, or expose a threat hiding within shadow.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: smoke-violet Ichor that fixes one shadow-echo into a temporary body or opens a short twilight passage

classes.name: Ichorborn Transmuter
classes.description: A combat alchemist who deliberately mutates their body, changes forms, and produces restorative or destructive compounds.
classes.core_identity: Prepared mutations, selectable side effects, bodily transformation, medicinal ichors, toxic attacks, and adaptive physiology.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Forest bogs and stagnant swamps favor oozes, insects, mutation, and aberrant life.
Toxic environments accelerate mutation, aberrant adaptation, oozes, and unnatural life.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Prepared Ichor mutations grant a strong bodily adaptation paired with a visible side effect or temporary vulnerability.
core_mechanics.field_expression: an alchemical adaptation zone that changes allies and terrain while destabilizing enemies
core_mechanics.counter_expression: mutate in response to the incoming threat and reflect a related biological effect
core_mechanics.apex_expression: enter a perfected composite form with several simultaneous adaptations and controlled side effects

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Study aberrant life without allowing it to spread uncontrolled, survive a mutation, contain an ooze or insectoid horror, or create a useful adaptation from dangerous flesh.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: prismatic aberrant Ichor that becomes a controlled mutation, medicinal compound, or destabilizing toxin

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Alchemical, concealable, and armor-integrated Thundercoils
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: A prepared mutation can grant temporary compatibility with a selected Thundercoil weapon, such as stabilizing recoil, resisting feedback, perceiving electrical fields, or safely handling a heated casing.
notes: The Ichorborn Transmuter understands Thundercoil Ichor as both an energy source and a dangerous transformative substance. Its class features may examine or manipulate fictional Ichor purity, contamination, heat, and corruption, but never provide real-world engineering or chemical instructions.
The Dagger can serve as an injector-like alchemical focus. Mini Thundercoils and Handguns may be integrated into mutagenic armor, while Grenades and Shock-Bombs carry specialized magical compounds.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

common_features: Ichor Adaptation: Prepared Ichor mutations grant a strong bodily adaptation paired with a visible side effect or temporary vulnerability.
Architect Mask Bounty: receive sealed Bounty Ichor and learn the class-specific bounty trigger.
Ichor Technique: spend 1 Bounty Ichor to express prismatic aberrant Ichor that becomes a controlled mutation, medicinal compound, or destabilizing toxin.
Weapon and Thundercoil Familiarity: apply the class’s listed training and preferred platforms.
Subclass: choose the melee/non-caster, half-caster, or full-caster path.
melee_non_caster_features: No spellcasting. Gain Ichor Maneuvers and weapon mastery.
half_caster_features: Half-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.
full_caster_features: Full-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Path Engine: non-caster and half-caster paths gain Extra Attack; full-caster path gains Potent Casting.
melee_non_caster_features: Extra Attack.
half_caster_features: Extra Attack.
full_caster_features: Potent Casting: add casting ability to one damage or healing roll each turn.

common_features: Subclass feature.

Integrated Conduction: class features may use infuse the hit with a selected mutation such as adhesion, sensory overload, corrosion, or regenerative theft through an eligible standard or Thundercoil weapon.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Greater Mutagen Vials: affect an additional target, larger area, or longer duration when spending 2 Bounty Ichor.
Subclass feature.
Path Mastery: non-caster improves weapon pressure; half-caster gains Ichor Spellstrike; full-caster gains Master Channeling.
melee_non_caster_features: Relentless Armament: once each turn, add one additional weapon die after spending Bounty Ichor.
half_caster_features: Ichor Spellstrike: combine a weapon hit and a spell effect once each turn.
full_caster_features: Master Channeling: alter range, area, or target count after spending Bounty Ichor.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Deep Reserve: regain 2 spent Bounty Ichor when initiative is rolled with none remaining; maximum reserve increases by 1.
Subclass feature.
Unbroken Ichor Adaptation: the core mechanic degrades rather than ending after one interruption, failed check, or forced movement.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Apex Bounty: once per Haven Rest, enter a perfected composite form with several simultaneous adaptations and controlled side effects.

Architect Mask’s Claim: when you roll initiative with no Bounty Ichor remaining, regain 1. Once per round, reduce the Ichor cost of a purely protective reaction by 1 (minimum 0); the feature still expends your reaction.
Ability Score Improvement or feat; Epic Boon eligibility when used by the campaign.
Ichorborn Transmuter Apotheosis: for 1 minute, begin each turn with at least 2 Bounty Ichor and invoke one subclass feature each round without its normal Ichor cost.

paths.name: Crimson Blade
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from manifested weapons, aggressive lifeforce control, and dueling. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Crimson Blade Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and infuse the hit with a selected mutation such as adhesion, sensory overload, corrosion, or regenerative theft. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Crimson Blade Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Crimson Blade Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of manifested weapons, aggressive lifeforce control, and dueling.

features_by_level.name: Crimson Blade Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Crimson Blade Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Sanguine Aegis
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from blood-chains, shared protection, and sacrifice-based support. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Sanguine Aegis Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Transmutation, Necromancy, Conjuration. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Sanguine Aegis Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses blood-chains, shared protection, and sacrifice-based support.

features_by_level.name: Sanguine Aegis Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Intelligence modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Sanguine Aegis Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

classes.description: A radiant flame-wielder who destroys undead, corruption, possession, and supernatural darkness while shielding allies.
classes.core_identity: Sacred fire, possession-breaking, protective circles, radiant barriers, spirit purification, and burning supernatural weaknesses.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Canopy settlements stand closest to sunlight, sky, birdsong, prophecy, and divine freedom.
Open wind-swept country belongs to sky, sunlight, freedom, birdsong, and far-traveling prophecy.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: The Exorcist identifies the spiritual weakness behind a corruption and seals it inside radiant fire before destroying or releasing it.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a sung circle of sunlight where hostile spirits weaken and allies resist corruption
core_mechanics.counter_expression: intercept a supernatural effect with a radiant ward and burn its source
core_mechanics.apex_expression: become a living dawn hymn that repeatedly purges darkness and shields every ally who can hear or see it

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Fulfill a true prophecy without coercing it, free a captive spirit, defend the sky or freedom of movement, or use music to guide a community through danger.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: sun-gold singing Ichor that forms a ward, reveals possession, or turns a weapon strike into cleansing flame

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Martial melee weapons and supernatural-hunting ranged weapons
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: The Exorcist may channel radiant, purification, or anti-undead features through a charged Thundercoil attack.
notes: The Dawnfire Exorcist uses radiant Thundercoils to disrupt undead bodies, possessed armor, cursed objects, and supernatural entities.

Its Hammer is ideal for breaking cursed objects, ritual fixtures, doors, and constructed vessels. Its Crossbow can pin dangerous creatures in place, while its Rifle delivers radiant suppression from outside a monster’s immediate reach.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

paths.name: Crescent Duelist
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from mobile moonlit dueling and radiant utility. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Crescent Duelist Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and brand the target with a dawn seal that exposes undead, curses, and possession. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Crescent Duelist Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Crescent Duelist Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of mobile moonlit dueling and radiant utility.

features_by_level.name: Crescent Duelist Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Crescent Duelist Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

beat_translation.movement: 1 Beat normally moves one range band or speed allotment

paths.resource_rule: Bounty Ichor is separate from spell slots, Focus, and Thundercoil Charge.

class_expression_anchor.active_feature_rule: Only this path’s features are active while its family is the confirmed active family for the class.

paths.name: Eclipse Warden
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from midline seals, countermagic, and protective control. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Eclipse Warden Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Abjuration, Evocation, Necromancy. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Eclipse Warden Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses midline seals, countermagic, and protective control.

features_by_level.name: Eclipse Warden Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Eclipse Warden Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Fullmoon Hierophant
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from radiant area control, cleansing, and powerful shields. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Fullmoon Hierophant Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Abjuration, Evocation, Necromancy, Divination. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Fullmoon Hierophant Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Fullmoon Hierophant Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to radiant area control, cleansing, and powerful shields; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Fullmoon Hierophant Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from terrain-based healing, snares, and restorative fields. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Grove Mendicant Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Enchantment, Conjuration, Transmutation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Grove Mendicant Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses terrain-based healing, snares, and restorative fields.

features_by_level.name: Grove Mendicant Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Grove Mendicant Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

beat_translation.movement: 1 Beat normally moves one range band or speed allotment

paths.name: Verdant Avatar
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from large-scale growth, battlefield terraforming, and entanglement. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Verdant Avatar Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Enchantment, Conjuration, Transmutation, Divination, Evocation. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Verdant Avatar Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Verdant Avatar Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to large-scale growth, battlefield terraforming, and entanglement; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Verdant Avatar Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

melee_non_caster.rule: This path has no class spellcasting. Ichor manifestations and Thundercoil effects are class features, not spells, unless an effect says otherwise.

half_caster.slot_progression: Universal shifted half-caster table beginning at class level 3.
half_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + half the class level rounded down (minimum 1).
half_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.
full_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + (class level − 2), minimum 1.
full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

alignment_profile.name: Dreamgrove Beastcaller
alignment_profile.core_identity: A primal enchanter who bonds with beasts and spirits through dreams, emotions, promises, and supernatural empathy.
practices: Protect natural kinship and family groups.
Calm predators when destruction is unnecessary.
Share senses, pain, and recovery with bonded creatures rather than commanding from safety.
hazards: Calling possessiveness love.
Treating bonded beings as extensions of the caller's will.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Protect natural kinship, preserve a breeding ground or family group, calm a predator without destroying it, or defend fertility from exploitation.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: warm amber Ichor that lets the caller share senses, pain, movement, or recovery with a bonded creature

classes.name: Stargrave Psychopomp
classes.description: A guide of souls who reads the heavens to find the dead, traverse spiritual boundaries, and escort spirits to their proper destination.
classes.core_identity: Astral navigation, communication with the dead, soul travel, celestial omens, spirit gates, and protection against creatures that consume souls.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Broken woodland edges are shifting thresholds suited to wanderers, shapeshifters, dreams, tricks, and threshold mischief.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: The Psychopomp reads soul position like a constellation and opens safe routes between body, dream, spirit, and afterlife.
core_mechanics.field_expression: an astral waystation where spirits cannot be stolen and allies can move through dreamlike paths
core_mechanics.counter_expression: step between body and soul to prevent death, possession, or forced displacement
core_mechanics.apex_expression: open a stargrave road through the battlefield, escorting allies and spirits between any marked points

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Guide a traveler across a dangerous threshold, resolve a dream-message, protect a wanderer, or return a mischievous spirit without cruelty.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: opal dream Ichor that reveals a soul-route, opens a brief gate, or anchors a spirit to safety

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Ritual blades, bows, and controlled sidearms
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: The Psychopomp can use a Thundercoil projectile or blade as the visible path for spirit magic, celestial guidance, or a soul-severing class feature.
notes: The Stargrave Psychopomp uses Thundercoils to disable bodies without necessarily destroying the souls attached to them.

Its Dagger functions as both ritual implement and emergency nerve-disrupting weapon. The Bow allows it to strike possessed or soul-draining creatures from a distance without relying on a loud firearm.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

common_features: Astral Passage: The Psychopomp reads soul position like a constellation and opens safe routes between body, dream, spirit, and afterlife.
Architect Mask Bounty: receive sealed Bounty Ichor and learn the class-specific bounty trigger.
Ichor Technique: spend 1 Bounty Ichor to express opal dream Ichor that reveals a soul-route, opens a brief gate, or anchors a spirit to safety.
Weapon and Thundercoil Familiarity: apply the class’s listed training and preferred platforms.
Subclass: choose the melee/non-caster, half-caster, or full-caster path.
melee_non_caster_features: No spellcasting. Gain Ichor Maneuvers and weapon mastery.
half_caster_features: Half-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.
full_caster_features: Full-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Path Engine: non-caster and half-caster paths gain Extra Attack; full-caster path gains Potent Casting.
melee_non_caster_features: Extra Attack.
half_caster_features: Extra Attack.
full_caster_features: Potent Casting: add casting ability to one damage or healing roll each turn.

common_features: Subclass feature.

Integrated Conduction: class features may use tancestry a luminous soul-line from the weapon to the target, revealing possession or spiritual displacement through an eligible standard or Thundercoil weapon.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Greater Soul Bearings: affect an additional target, larger area, or longer duration when spending 2 Bounty Ichor.
Subclass feature.
Path Mastery: non-caster improves weapon pressure; half-caster gains Ichor Spellstrike; full-caster gains Master Channeling.
melee_non_caster_features: Relentless Armament: once each turn, add one additional weapon die after spending Bounty Ichor.
half_caster_features: Ichor Spellstrike: combine a weapon hit and a spell effect once each turn.
full_caster_features: Master Channeling: alter range, area, or target count after spending Bounty Ichor.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Deep Reserve: regain 2 spent Bounty Ichor when initiative is rolled with none remaining; maximum reserve increases by 1.
Subclass feature.
Unbroken Astral Passage: the core mechanic degrades rather than ending after one interruption, failed check, or forced movement.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Apex Bounty: once per Haven Rest, open a stargrave road through the battlefield, escorting allies and spirits between any marked points.

Architect Mask’s Claim: when you roll initiative with no Bounty Ichor remaining, regain 1. Once per round, reduce the Ichor cost of a purely protective reaction by 1 (minimum 0); the feature still expends your reaction.
Ability Score Improvement or feat; Epic Boon eligibility when used by the campaign.
Stargrave Psychopomp Apotheosis: for 1 minute, begin each turn with at least 2 Bounty Ichor and invoke one subclass feature each round without its normal Ichor cost.

paths.name: Last-Light Guardian
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from frontline protection, radiant retaliation, and death-denial. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Last-Light Guardian Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and tancestry a luminous soul-line from the weapon to the target, revealing possession or spiritual displacement. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Last-Light Guardian Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Last-Light Guardian Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of frontline protection, radiant retaliation, and death-denial.

features_by_level.name: Last-Light Guardian Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Last-Light Guardian Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Astral Mind Psychopomp Echo

An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round. This feature is the Full Psi psionic expression of Stargrave Psychopomp.

features_by_level.name: Astral Mind Psychopomp Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to long-range restoration, timeline reversals, and mass resurrection; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity. This feature is the Full Psi psionic expression of Stargrave Psychopomp.

features_by_level.name: Astral Mind Psychopomp Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. alignment_profile.name: Stargrave Psychopomp
alignment_profile.core_identity: A guide of souls who reads the heavens to find the dead, traverse spiritual boundaries, and escort spirits to their proper destination.
practices: Guide travelers and souls across dangerous thresholds.
Resolve dream messages honestly.
Return mischievous or displaced spirits without cruelty when possible.
hazards: Deciding another soul's destination without listening.
Serving the dead so completely that the living become incidental.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Guide a traveler across a dangerous threshold, resolve a dream-message, protect a wanderer, or return a mischievous spirit without cruelty.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: opal dream Ichor that reveals a soul-route, opens a brief gate, or anchors a spirit to safety

classes.name: Tempest Swarmbinder
classes.description: A battlefield controller who commands storms through swarms, summoned creatures, tentacles, spirits, or elemental manifestations.
classes.core_identity: Storm creatures, moving hazardous zones, pushing enemies into lightning fields, aerial control, and coordinated swarm attacks.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Her dominion over tides, hidden waters, and ocean habitats and settlements includes settlements that live directly upon the sea.
Reefs are one of Bastveig’s explicit sacred domains and the heart of her hidden-water habitats.
Open underwater reaches and trenchward seas remain under the Lady of Reefs and Trenches.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Summons, swarms, terrain, and allies become conductive nodes that redirect storms and forced movement.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a moving reef-storm of swarms, tentacles, wind, and conductive rain
core_mechanics.counter_expression: have the living circuit seize an incoming effect and carry it along a safer current
core_mechanics.apex_expression: awaken a trench-tempest ecosystem whose summoned nodes move and attack every round

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Protect hidden waters, preserve an ocean civilization, recover knowledge from a trench, or guide travelers safely through tides and reefs.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: deep-cyan Ichor under impossible pressure that creates a storm node or summons a reef-born current-spirit

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Area-control weapons, projectile weapons, explosives, and deployed systems
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: A swarm may mark conductive paths between creatures, objects, or areas. Class features can use those paths to determine visual arcs, forced movement, or secondary effects.
notes: The Tempest Swarmbinder uses summoned creatures and storm manifestations to guide electrical arcs, herd enemies, and occupy dangerous firing lanes.
Shock-Bombs and Grenades reinforce forced-movement tactics. The Coil Array establishes a major storm-control zone, while the Bow and Rifle allow precise attacks through or around a moving swarm.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

paths.name: Tide Dancer
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from evasive water-laced melee and debilitation. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Tide Dancer Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and connect the target to a nearby node and pull, push, or arc energy between them. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Tide Dancer Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Tide Dancer Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of evasive water-laced melee and debilitation.

features_by_level.name: Tide Dancer Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Tide Dancer Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Fog Cantor
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from healing mist, disorientation, and controlled retreat. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Fog Cantor Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Evocation, Conjuration, Transmutation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Fog Cantor Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses healing mist, disorientation, and controlled retreat.

features_by_level.name: Fog Cantor Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Fog Cantor Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Riddleblade
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from perception manipulation, riddles, and reality-bending melee. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Riddleblade Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and tag the target with forensic residue that reveals its next likely action or hidden resistance. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Riddleblade Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Riddleblade Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of perception manipulation, riddles, and reality-bending melee.

features_by_level.name: Riddleblade Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Riddleblade Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.name: Forbidden Ritualist
paths.identity: A weapon-and-magic path built from dark rituals, control, and dangerous knowledge. It mixes melee or ranged combat with a rank 1–5 spell progression and uses Bounty Ichor to join attacks, fields, and spells.

features_by_level.name: Forbidden Ritualist Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Divination, Abjuration, Transmutation. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature.

features_by_level.name: Forbidden Ritualist Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses dark rituals, control, and dangerous knowledge.

features_by_level.name: Forbidden Ritualist Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Intelligence modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range.

features_by_level.name: Forbidden Ritualist Dominion
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. Its temporary hit points and speed penalty apply each round without further Ichor cost, and you may move the field up to 20 feet as a 1-Beat swift action.

paths.name: Pathseer
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from divination, future-reading, time manipulation, and revealed routes. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Pathseer Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Intelligence. You prepare spells from Divination, Abjuration, Transmutation, Enchantment. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Pathseer Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Pathseer Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to divination, future-reading, time manipulation, and revealed routes; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Pathseer Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

alignment_profile.name: Fate-Eye Savant
alignment_profile.core_identity: A supernatural investigator who identifies hidden weaknesses, predicts crimes or attacks, and dismantles magic through analysis.
practices: Assess evidence impartially under pressure.
Create countermeasures that preserve both civilization and instinct.
Stop engineered solutions from becoming exploitation.
hazards: Treating surveillance as understanding.
Accepting suffering because a model labels it efficient.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Make an impartial assessment under pressure, design an adaptation that preserves civilization and instinct, or stop an engineered solution from becoming exploitation.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: ivory-gold Ichor that records one observed fact and converts it into a precise countermeasure

classes.name: Relentless Doomtracker
classes.description: An unstoppable hunter who designates one target and pursues it through injury, death, distance, concealment, and supernatural escape.
classes.core_identity: Target marking, relentless pursuit, escalating single-target damage, survival at zero health, and denying a chosen enemy any safe escape.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Dense living woodland directly reflects her dominion over forests, hunters, moonlight, and wilderness.
Mangrove forests are living thresholds between land and water, suited to wilderness and hidden hunters.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: A chosen quarry accumulates pursuit marks that survive concealment, range changes, and many forms of escape.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a moonlit hunting ground where the quarry cannot hide and allies share pursuit routes
core_mechanics.counter_expression: refuse incapacitation long enough to answer the quarry’s escape or attack
core_mechanics.apex_expression: declare an inescapable hunt, maintaining pressure through every range and surviving until the quarry is resolved

When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.

paths.name: Predator-Sense Hunter
paths.identity: A partial psionic path for the Relentless Doomtracker that overlays disciplined thought, empathy, telepathy, or psychokinesis onto Target marking, relentless pursuit, escalating single-target damage, survival at zero health, and denying a chosen enemy any safe escape. It uses the class-specific half-caster progression and Wisdom as its psionic ability.

psionic_profile.implementation_rule: Psionics use the existing spell-slot, saving-throw, attack-modifier, action-economy, and concentration systems unless a later dedicated psionics rules file explicitly overrides a field.

features_by_level.name: Predator-Sense Hunter Conduit
features_by_level.description: Gain half-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Divination, Transmutation, Abjuration. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, you may expend one spell slot to deal an additional 1d8 thematic damage per rank of the slot, or to apply an equivalent healing or control rider defined by the feature. This feature is the Half-Psi psionic expression of Relentless Doomtracker.

features_by_level.name: Predator-Sense Hunter Relay
features_by_level.description: As an action, or by spending 2 Bounty Ichor as a 1-Beat swift action, create a 10-foot-radius class field at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute. You can have only one such field. At the start of an ally’s turn in the field, it gains temporary hit points equal to your PB. An enemy that enters the field for the first time on a turn or starts there must succeed on a class-feature saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until its next turn. The field expresses hybrid debuffs, spell-melee chains, and control. This feature is the Half-Psi psionic expression of Relentless Doomtracker.

features_by_level.name: Predator-Sense Hunter Counter
features_by_level.description: When you or an ally in your class field takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your PB + your Wisdom modifier. You may then move the field up to 20 feet or make one weapon attack against the source if it is in range. This feature is the Half-Psi psionic expression of Relentless Doomtracker.

features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enlarge your class field to a 20-foot radius for 1 minute. paths.name: Dissolution Sage
paths.identity: A dedicated magical path built from area decay, erosion, and distant corruption. It rarely needs weapons, reaches spell rank 9, and spends Bounty Ichor to reshape area, range, timing, or target count.

features_by_level.name: Dissolution Sage Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Wisdom. You prepare spells from Divination, Transmutation, Abjuration, Enchantment. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first.

features_by_level.name: Dissolution Sage Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round.

features_by_level.name: Dissolution Sage Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to area decay, erosion, and distant corruption; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity.

features_by_level.name: Dissolution Sage Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.
