full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

alignment_profile.name: Relentless Doomtracker
alignment_profile.core_identity: An unstoppable hunter who designates one target and pursues it through injury, death, distance, concealment, and supernatural escape.
practices: Complete difficult hunts without waste.
Protect wild thresholds and the innocent from predators.
Honor surrender, changed evidence, and the possibility that the quarry was misidentified.
hazards: Allowing pursuit to become identity.
Denying mercy because escape would make the hunt incomplete.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Complete a difficult hunt without waste, protect a wild threshold, expose a predator threatening the innocent, or honor moonlit wilderness law.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: silver-green Ichor that preserves a quarry trail, sustains the hunter, or changes form to suit the range of pursuit

classes.name: Covenant Aegis
classes.description: A dedicated protector who creates magical bonds between party members, redistributes damage, and turns the entire group into one defensive formation.
classes.core_identity: Shared defenses, damage interception, party-wide barriers, linked saving throws, retaliatory protection, and maintaining a formation under overwhelming pressure.

assigned_terraforming_areas.terraforming_rationale: Sheltered valleys naturally gather settlements, dynasties, inheritance, agriculture, marriage, and ordered civilization.

classes.era_invariance: This class and all six paths are mechanically available in every era and location. Era changes tools, vocabulary, access, and fiction—not the class chassis.

core_mechanics.core_rule: Willing allies form Covenant Links that distribute protection, movement, saving throws, and retaliatory force through the group.
core_mechanics.field_expression: a sanctioned formation in which allies share barriers, movement, and recovery
core_mechanics.counter_expression: intercept harm through the covenant and redirect part of it into the attacker or reservoir
core_mechanics.apex_expression: unite the party into one sovereign defensive body with shared reactions and continuously renewing barriers

bounty_ichor.starting_reserve_formula: PB + the class spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 2; use the listed primary mental ability for the non-caster path)
bounty_ichor.refresh: Regain all expended Bounty Ichor when you finish a Haven Rest. When the listed bounty trigger is completed during initiative, regain 1 expended Ichor, no more than once per round and never above the reserve maximum. The same creature, object, or event can satisfy the trigger only once.
bounty_ichor.bounty_trigger: Protect a lawful bond, preserve inheritance or family continuity, reconcile a community without erasing its members, or uphold social order against predation.
bounty_ichor.Architect mask_boon_expression: ivory-shadow Ichor that seals a voluntary covenant and stores intercepted harm in a shared reservoir

subclass_use.melee_non_caster: Primary power source. Spent on weapon maneuvers, Thundercoil riders, pursuit, counters, and survival. No spell slots.
subclass_use.half_caster: Shared between weapon techniques, spellstrikes, fields, and rank 1–5 magic.
subclass_use.full_caster: Mostly spent to amplify, echo, protect, or reshape rank 1–9 magic; weapons are rarely required.

bounty_ichor.fictional_safety: Bounty Ichor and Thundercoil Ichor are fictional tabletop materials; this dataset contains no real-world construction, chemistry, electronics, or weapon instructions.

rules_limits.maximum_formula: PB + relevant class ability modifier, minimum 2
rules_limits.no_farming: A target or event satisfies a bounty only once unless the DM rules that it has become a genuinely new threat.
rules_limits.long_rest: All spent Ichor returns after a Haven Rest.

thundercoil_integration.training: Defensive melee weapons, close-control firearms, and emplacement systems
thundercoil_integration.signature_description: When the Aegis intercepts damage or moves to protect an ally, it may combine that reaction with an eligible charged Thundercoil strike when permitted by its class progression.
notes: The Covenant Aegis uses Thundercoils to interrupt attackers, deny reactions, force enemies away from allies, and defend fixed positions.

The Hammer is its signature Thundercoil because it supports non-lethal control, breaching, and forced movement. The Sword provides defensive parries, while the Shotgun protects doorways, corridors, and wounded companions.
universal_rules: Thundercoils are optional equipment and do not replace standard weapons or spells.
The wielder must be proficient with the underlying weapon type.
Normal charge-pack, heat, Overload, Ichor-instability, maintenance, and corruption rules remain in force.
A class feature delivered through a Thundercoil attack does not grant free charges or extra Overloads unless it explicitly says so.

common_features: Sanctioned Formation: Willing allies form Covenant Links that distribute protection, movement, saving throws, and retaliatory force through the group.
Architect Mask Bounty: receive sealed Bounty Ichor and learn the class-specific bounty trigger.
Ichor Technique: spend 1 Bounty Ichor to express ivory-shadow Ichor that seals a voluntary covenant and stores intercepted harm in a shared reservoir.
Weapon and Thundercoil Familiarity: apply the class’s listed training and preferred platforms.
Subclass: choose the melee/non-caster, half-caster, or full-caster path.
melee_non_caster_features: No spellcasting. Gain Ichor Maneuvers and weapon mastery.
half_caster_features: Half-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.
full_caster_features: Full-caster spellcasting begins at spell rank 1.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Path Engine: non-caster and half-caster paths gain Extra Attack; full-caster path gains Potent Casting.
melee_non_caster_features: Extra Attack.
half_caster_features: Extra Attack.
full_caster_features: Potent Casting: add casting ability to one damage or healing roll each turn.

common_features: Subclass feature.
Integrated Conduction: class features may use extend a protective link to an ally and punish the target for attacking outside the formation through an eligible standard or Thundercoil weapon.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Greater Covenant Links: affect an additional target, larger area, or longer duration when spending 2 Bounty Ichor.
Subclass feature.
Path Mastery: non-caster improves weapon pressure; half-caster gains Ichor Spellstrike; full-caster gains Master Channeling.
melee_non_caster_features: Relentless Armament: once each turn, add one additional weapon die after spending Bounty Ichor.
half_caster_features: Ichor Spellstrike: combine a weapon hit and a spell effect once each turn.
full_caster_features: Master Channeling: alter range, area, or target count after spending Bounty Ichor.

common_features: Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Deep Reserve: regain 2 spent Bounty Ichor when initiative is rolled with none remaining; maximum reserve increases by 1.
Subclass feature.
Unbroken Sanctioned Formation: the core mechanic degrades rather than ending after one interruption, failed check, or forced movement.
Ability Score Improvement or feat.
Apex Bounty: once per Haven Rest, unite the party into one sovereign defensive body with shared reactions and continuously renewing barriers.

Architect Mask’s Claim: when you roll initiative with no Bounty Ichor remaining, regain 1. Once per round, reduce the Ichor cost of a purely protective reaction by 1 (minimum 0); the feature still expends your reaction.
Ability Score Improvement or feat; Epic Boon eligibility when used by the campaign.
Covenant Aegis Apotheosis: for 1 minute, begin each turn with at least 2 Bounty Ichor and invoke one subclass feature each round without its normal Ichor cost.

paths.name: Iron Reliquary
paths.identity: A weapon-first path built from durable interception, positional guarding, and retaliatory construct strikes. It has no spell slots and relies on standard weapons, Thundercoils, positioning, and Architect-coded Bounty Ichor.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Bounty
features_by_level.description: When you hit with a proficient standard or Thundercoil weapon, spend 1 Bounty Ichor to add 1d6 themed damage and extend a protective link to an ally and punish the target for attacking outside the formation. The die becomes d8 at level 10 and d10 at level 17. This path never gains spellcasting.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Pursuit
features_by_level.description: After you spend Bounty Ichor on Iron Reliquary Bounty, you may move up to half your speed without provoking interception reactions from the affected target. Until the start of your next turn, you gain +2 AC against that target. This expression retains the path theme of durable interception, positional guarding, and retaliatory construct strikes.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Reversal
features_by_level.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, use your reaction and spend 1 Bounty Ichor to reduce that damage by 1d10 + your PB + your relevant class ability modifier. If the source is within your weapon’s range, you may make one weapon attack against it as part of the same reaction.

features_by_level.name: Iron Reliquary Apex
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, or by spending 3 Bounty Ichor, enter a martial apex for 1 minute. The first Ichor Maneuver you use on each of your turns costs 0 Ichor, and after you hit with a weapon you may move 10 feet without provoking from that target. This path never gains spellcasting.

paths.identity: A blended psionic-and-spellcasting path for the Covenant Aegis that joins noetic disciplines to the class's canonical magical tradition. It uses the existing full-caster-compatible progression and Charisma so ActiveWorkspace math, spell suggestions, multiclass calculations, and search remain automatic.

psionic_profile.implementation_rule: Psionics use the existing spell-slot, saving-throw, attack-modifier, action-economy, and concentration systems unless a later dedicated psionics rules file explicitly overrides a field.

features_by_level.name: Covenant Psicaster Invocation
features_by_level.description: Gain full-caster spellcasting using Charisma. You prepare spells from Abjuration, Enchantment, Evocation, Conjuration. When you cast a class spell, you may spend 1 Bounty Ichor to choose one: increase its range by 30 feet; change its damage to a class-appropriate type; or add one additional target when the spell normally targets only one creature and the second target is within 30 feet of the first. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Covenant Aegis.

features_by_level.name: Covenant Psicaster Echo
features_by_level.description: Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a spell that targets only one creature and is not Self-range, choose a second legal target. The echo uses the same attack roll; if it requires a saving throw, the second target has one Edge. An echoed effect deals or restores half the rolled amount and cannot impose a condition lasting longer than one round. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Covenant Aegis.

features_by_level.name: Covenant Psicaster Mastery
features_by_level.description: Choose one damage type or control theme central to ranged soul-light damage, reservoir bursts, and offensive support; you gain resistance to that damage type when appropriate. Once per turn when you spend Bounty Ichor on a class spell, that spell ignores resistance to one of its damage types for that casting, but never ignores immunity. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Covenant Aegis.

features_by_level.name: Covenant Psicaster Apotheosis
features_by_level.description: Once per Haven Rest, cast one prepared class spell of rank 6 or lower without expending a spell slot and apply one level-3 Bounty Ichor modification without spending Ichor. The spell still follows its normal casting time, components, concentration, attack, and saving-throw rules. This feature is the Hybrid Psicaster psionic expression of Covenant Aegis.

beat_translation.movement: 1 Beat normally moves one range band or speed allotment

paths.resource_rule: Bounty Ichor is separate from spell slots, Focus, and Thundercoil Charge.

melee_non_caster.rule: This path has no class spellcasting. Ichor manifestations and Thundercoil effects are class features, not spells, unless an effect says otherwise.

half_caster.slot_progression: Universal shifted half-caster table beginning at class level 3.
half_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + half the class level rounded down (minimum 1).
half_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

full_caster.slot_progression: Full-caster slot table delayed until subclass selection at class level 3; class level 3 uses the standard level-1 full-caster row.
full_caster.cantrips_known: 3 at class level 3, 4 at level 10, and 5 at level 17.
full_caster.preparation_formula: Prepare a number of class spells equal to the spellcasting ability modifier + (class level − 2), minimum 1.
full_caster.selection_rule: Choose spells from the allowed schools that appear on at least one approved Architect Engine spell catalog, plus any spell explicitly granted by a class feature.

alignment_profile.name: Covenant Aegis
alignment_profile.core_identity: Shared defenses, damage interception, party-wide barriers, linked saving throws, retaliatory protection, and maintaining a formation under overwhelming pressure.
practices: Protect voluntary bonds and lawful continuity.
Reconcile communities without erasing members.
Share harm and defense without making membership compulsory.
hazards: Turning unity into enforced sameness.
Sacrificing the individual because the formation remains standing.
alignment_profile.bounty_trigger: Protect a lawful bond, preserve inheritance or family continuity, reconcile a community without erasing its members, or uphold social order against predation.
alignment_profile.Architect mask_boon: ivory-shadow Ichor that seals a voluntary covenant and stores intercepted harm in a shared reservoir

class_expression_system.path_switching: The active path family is derived from Spellcraft and Psionic Discipline thresholds and confirmed by the player at level-up. Martial Practice controls training and loadout access.
